author: Arhaan2
scope: exploratory on-device workflow validation; editor isolation unverified

recovery.bug: The original converter launcher dereferenced the virtual-environment Python symlink and executed system Python for its package check.
recovery.fix: A separately versioned launch helper makes the configured interpreter absolute before subprocess directory changes without dereferencing it; package checks and conversion use that same executable.
recovery.authorization_scope: One explicitly authorized manual recovery after the documented precheck failure; no re-import and no automatic retries.
recovery.regression_test: A real temporary symlink-based virtual environment is launched through the production helper after a working-directory change; a module installed only in that environment must remain importable.

environment.initial_offline_probe_correction: The initial import probe omitted production MLC_LLM_HOME and attempted the default cache outside the workspace. The preserved diagnostic identified PermissionError. This verification uses the unchanged production conversion cache/environment settings; no converter or runtime execution was retried.
environment.path_privacy: Exact interpreter, sys.prefix, sys.base_prefix and import paths are retained privately; public paths are relative to the verified virtual environment.

failure.failure: CalledProcessError during the pinned converter package metadata check
failure.cause: Resolving the configured virtual-environment Python symlink selects the base/system interpreter, where apache-tvm-ffi package metadata is absent. The configured virtual environment itself contains the exact pinned packages.

proposal_provenance.basis: User-supplied original exploratory proposal based on the supplied development packet.
proposal_provenance.declared_session_tools: File-reading and JSON-parsing tools were used to ingest the supplied packet.
proposal_provenance.declared_session_exclusions: No external research, additional weight inspections, or target forward passes were used in the proposal session.
proposal_provenance.observation_limit: This is the supplied provenance declaration; editor isolation remains unverified.
proposal_provenance.causality: Selected columns are not a verified causal explanation for repetition.

resources.host_scope: host-wide samples include unrelated workloads; not model-attributed physical GPU memory
resources.owned_process_scope: maximum single observed process per role; RSS/footprint can include shared memory
resources.worker_scope: GPUBuffer descriptor accounting and WASM address space are not physical VRAM
resources.sampling_limit: Observed sample maxima do not establish absolute peaks; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.

worker_signals.label: Tracked live GPUBuffer sizes
worker_signals.reason: Sum of buffer descriptor sizes not explicitly destroyed on this device. Includes runtime pool buffers; excludes textures, driver overhead and physical VRAM residency.

worker_signals.label: GPU device lifecycle
worker_signals.reason: Unexpected loss is a failed run; destroy during unload is an expected lifecycle event.

worker_signals.label: Reachable WASM linear memory
worker_signals.reason: Linear address-space length, not resident RAM. A retained buffer after unload does not prove a leak; garbage collection is not forced.

worker_signals.label: Worker JS heap
worker_signals.reason: performance.memory is not exposed in this worker.

worker_signals.label: Worker timer delay
worker_signals.reason: Worker responsiveness; includes scheduling and synchronous work, not CPU usage.

worker_signals.label: Reachable WASM linear memory
worker_signals.reason: Linear address-space length, not resident RAM; may remain reachable after unload. No forced GC.

resources.worker_series_scope: one complete worker run, including load, warmup, requests and cleanup; the client repeats this shared series on every terminal output

initialization.scope: Observed GPUQueue.submit calls before application generation; includes runtime initialization/compilation work. No claim of zero model computation during loading.
initialization.runtimeAutomaticModelWarmup: Not separately identifiable from initialization submissions; no application warmup or debug evaluate() call requested

paired.paired_estimand: equal item mean of scheduled sample correctness
paired.interpretation: paired descriptive comparison; experimental claims require the declared controls and independent provenance

confidence_interval.method: paired percentile bootstrap clustered by item

paired.uncertainty_scope: one preselected comparison; candidate-selection uncertainty is not included
paired.weighting: equal item weight; mean of scheduled repeats

selection.rule: Compare all 32 fixed development items; prefer candidate only for strictly higher strict prompt compliance with complete technical execution and grading; ties retain pristine.

token_accounting: Four injected empty-thinking prefix IDs count toward max_tokens but not reported completion tokens. A 1024 cap permits at most 1020 sampled tokens; the 16-token warmup cap permits at most 12. Reservations retain 1024/16 bounds.
